rows.label: Plywood consisting solely of sheets, with both outer plies of coniferous wood

title.en-US: Plywood consisting solely of sheets, with both outer plies of coniferous wood
title.zh-CN: 仅由单板组成且两外层均为针叶材的胶合板

classification_refs.title: Plywood consisting solely of sheets, with both outer plies of coniferous wood

identity.covered_products: Solely veneer-sheet plywood whose face and back are independently coniferous; represented here by untreated uncoated all-coniferous PF panels
identity.excluded_products: Non-coniferous face or back; non-veneer cores; bamboo; parallel-grain laminates; coated/treated panels; uncured or rejected reference output; unassessed alternative technology
identity.representative_product: Flat crossed full-sheet all-coniferous plywood, purchased aqueous resole PF formulated glue, actual declared structural/bond grade and measured release-state geometry
identity.production_route: Untreated logs → debark/condition → rotary peel/clip → indirect steam dry/redry → PF spread/full-sheet layup → hot press/cure/cool → trim/grade finish → first release → pack; gas-only boiler and electric handling
identity.market_state: Cured, cooled, trimmed, grade-finished and quality-released factory panel; packing is accompanying material and is excluded from net panel volume

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 两外层均针叶材；全针叶芯；气炉供热；按1m³实测板体积，逐层种属与蒸汽/树脂账本。

rows.label: Plywood consisting solely of sheets, with at least one outer ply of tropical wood

title.en-US: Plywood with at least one tropical outer ply — integrated rotary-veneer PF route
title.zh-CN: 至少一外层为热带木材的胶合板——旋切单板一体化 PF 路线

classification_refs.title: Plywood consisting solely of sheets, with at least one outer ply of tropical wood

identity.covered_products: At least one tropical meranti-group outer ply; all-veneer crossed tropical hardwood panel; untreated/uncoated aqueous resole PF manufacture and accepted factory state
identity.excluded_products: No tropical outer ply; non-veneer cores; bamboo; parallel-grain products; other glue/heat/effluent routes; coated/treated or unaccepted final products
identity.representative_product: Meranti-faced tropical all-veneer PF plywood, actual ply species, thicknesses and quality grade declared without assumed proportions
identity.production_route: Log yard/wash—debark/buck/rotary peel/clip—indirect steam dry/cool/redry—select/patch—PF spread/crossed layup/prepress where used—hot cure—cool/trim/sand—first release/pack; clean chip boiler and controls included
identity.market_state: Cured, cooled, trimmed, grade-finished and accepted flat panel at the producing factory, with packaging separately accounted; downstream fabrication excluded

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 至少一热带外层；meranti代表路线；清洁木片蒸汽；按1kg放行板，热带种属/芯层/锅炉边界明确。

rows.label: Plywood consisting solely of sheets, with at least one outer ply of non-coniferous wood other than tropical

title.en-US: Non-tropical non-coniferous-faced all-veneer plywood — integrated aqueous resole PF manufacture
title.zh-CN: 非热带非针叶木外层全单板胶合板——一体化水性甲阶 PF 制造

classification_refs.title: Plywood consisting solely of sheets, with at least one outer ply of non-coniferous wood other than tropical

identity.covered_products: Integrated-log aqueous resole PF all-veneer crossed flat panels with at least one non-tropical non-coniferous outer ply and no tropical outer ply; actual inner species/mixed layups require species-specific bonding and shipment acceptance
identity.excluded_products: Both-coniferous outer plies or any tropical outer ply; other core structures; other adhesives; purchased-veneer assembly; coated/chemically treated panels; wet uncured or unaccepted final-output states
identity.representative_product: Shipment-ready uncoated PF all-veneer panel with at least one non-tropical non-coniferous outer ply and no tropical outer ply, measured inner species/layup and recipe; no species proportions or glue rate assumed
identity.production_route: Conditioning—peeling/slicing—drying—PF preparation/spreading/layup—hot press/cure—cool—trim/grade-dependent sand—accept/pack; on-site heat included
identity.market_state: Cured, cooled, trimmed, sanded where the grade requires it and accepted uncoated flat panel at factory shipment gate; semi-finished construction material, not uncured intermediate

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 保留非热带阔叶外层PF路线；只排除热带外层，允许热带芯层；存在旧ADR范围不同步问题。

classification_refs.title: General interest newspapers and periodicals, other than daily, in print

identity.covered_products: General-interest print magazines issued less than four times a week, on coated paper by heatset web offset and saddle stitching, with declared self/separate paper cover
identity.excluded_products: CPC 32420 business/professional/academic and CPC 32490 other specific-subject periodicals; online editions; publications issued four or more times a week; other routes in section 1; no full-leaf coverage
identity.representative_product: General-interest news/current-affairs print magazine; The Week illustrates content and weekly delivery only, PGM the heatset saddle-stitch route only; actual issue and physical specifications verified separately
identity.production_route: Purchased coated paper; process-free plate imaging; wet heatset print/dry/abatement/chill; folded signatures; wire saddle stitching; trim; conditional packing
identity.market_state: Accepted complete magazine at printer gate; transport packaging excluded from net reference mass

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 保留一般兴趣杂志；热固轮转、气烧干燥/VOC治理、金属丝骑马订；排除另两期刊身份。

title.en-US: Business, professional or academic newspapers and periodicals, other than daily, in print
title.zh-CN: 非每日出版的商业、专业或学术报纸及期刊（印刷版）

classification_refs.title: Business, professional or academic newspapers and periodicals, other than daily, in print

identity.covered_products: Physical non-daily professional/academic serial issues matching the monochrome coated-sheet self-cover wet-offset and wire-saddle-stitched construction
identity.excluded_products: General reference books including serial instalments, directories, monographs, blank notebooks, online-only content, general-interest/other periodicals and the other constructions in section 1
identity.representative_product: A declared professional or academic serial issue with black text/grayscale figures, self-cover, nested signatures and wire stitches; no default pagination, format, grammage, run length or frequency within the category
identity.production_route: Supplied coated paper and prepared plates; wet sheetfed offset, pile setting, folding/nesting, issue/sequence control, saddle stitching, trim, first acceptance and packing
identity.market_state: Complete readable issue at printer gate; net mass includes self-cover, retained ink/powder, stitches and moisture; excludes transport packaging

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 专业/学术读者与连续出版证据；黑色单张纸湿胶印、自封面、钢丝订；序列和跨页/签帖验收。

rows.label: Other newspapers and periodicals, other than daily, in print

title.en-US: Other newspapers and periodicals, other than daily, in print
title.zh-CN: 其他非每日出版的印刷报纸和期刊

classification_refs.title: Other newspapers and periodicals, other than daily, in print

identity.covered_products: Serial specific-subject non-daily printed zines in the residual other-periodical category, with the monochrome stencil and single-sheet folded construction in section 1
identity.excluded_products: General-interest and business/professional/academic periodicals; daily and online-only publications; reference books and directories; one-off booklets without serial evidence; other routes listed in section 1
identity.representative_product: An actual issue of a continuing single-subject fanzine, printed in black on one uncoated sheet and folded with its own cover; title, topic, frequency, layout and grade collected rather than invented
identity.production_route: Received unprinted sheet and composite master roll; digital imposition, thermal master making, proof/replacement, black emulsion drum printing, ambient setting, cut/slit/fold, first finished-product quality release and actual packing
identity.market_state: Complete readable folded issue at first finished-product quality release, measured net moisture state, before transport packing

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 特定主题连续zine；黑乳液数字孔版、单张切折、不加胶/金属订；废母版/乳液账本。

title.en-US: Sheetfed offset printed, EVA perfect bound educational textbooks
title.zh-CN: 单张纸胶印、EVA胶订教育教材

identity.covered_products: Complete printed educational textbooks primarily for students or teachers in formal study programmes, including workbooks, teachers’ manuals, resource and interactive materials only in the declared sheetfed/uncoated/nonreactive-EVA/unlaminated paperback form.
identity.excluded_products: General reference books, directories, professional/technical/scholarly books, non-textbook children’s books, other general-interest books, printed music and trade-advertising/commercial catalogues are outside this PCR; shared manufacture does not confer textbook identity. Also excluded: hardcover, sewn/stitched/spiral/PUR, board/pop-up/toy/electronic products; loose-sheet/folio sets and non-printed handwritten originals; laminated/varnished/foiled/insertion-rich publications; heatset/web, saddle-stitched or loose/folded forms; alternative printing/drying routes, 3D/prototype printing, non-paper substrates, postal/licensing/performance services and integrated paper production.
identity.representative_product: Complete educational textbook of one declared edition and student/teacher course design, with uncoated pages, printed flexible paper cover and EVA milled-spine perfect binding.
identity.production_route: CTP process-free plate → conventional wet sheetfed offset → absorption/oxidative setting → fold/gather → mill/glue/cover → trim/inspect/dispatch.
identity.market_state: Accepted complete educational textbook at printer factory gate; dispatch packaging recorded separately.

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 保留正式教学目的完整纸质教材；单张纸胶印EVA平装；排除其他七类内容身份。

identity.covered_products: General-public printed dictionaries and encyclopedia volumes, including identified reference-title installments, only with the declared monochrome sheetfed/uncoated/sewn/paper-covered hardcase construction.
identity.excluded_products: Contact directories; formal-study textbooks; specialized professional/technical/scholarly or children's titles; daily/non-daily newspapers and periodicals; advertising catalogues; electronic/audio publications; all alternative physical constructions and routes excluded in section 1.
identity.representative_product: One edition/volume design of a complete sewn dictionary or encyclopedia with uncoated text/endpapers, printed paper wrap over greyboard, polyester thread, cotton mull, paper backliner and aqueous PVAc adhesives.
identity.production_route: File/edition proof and imposition → process-free CTP → black wet sheetfed offset and absorption/oxidative setting → fold/gather/verify → thread sew/nip/glue-off/backline/dry → three-side trim; parallel cut board/print wrap/case make → case-in/press/joint set/dry → quality release → pack.
identity.market_state: First-quality-released complete bound volume at manufacturing gate, net of dispatch packaging.

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 公众辞典/百科；线缝灰板硬壳、PVAc三用途胶、背衬/布/thread账本，与原EVA软封不同。

identity.covered_products: Printed collections of systematically organized contact information with optional entity descriptions, in the selected black-only sheetfed/EVA softcover construction.
identity.excluded_products: Dictionaries/encyclopaedias and other general reference books; professional prose books; daily or non-daily periodicals; product-price advertising catalogues without directory function; online/database/enquiry services; other printing, binding and finishing constructions.
identity.representative_product: One edition of a black-only business/trade contact directory, with ordered entity listings, category index and page locators, uncoated woodfree text/cover and nonreactive EVA milled-spine binding. No standard dimensions, listing count or mass are imposed.
identity.production_route: Approved directory snapshot and imposition → CTP imaging → text/cover wet sheetfed offset and setting → folding/gathering by signature sequence → milling/EVA gluing/cover attachment → trimming → listing/index/page and binding acceptance → packing.
identity.market_state: Newly first-released complete printed directories at printer gate; retained text, cover, ink, glue and actual powder included; delivery packaging separately accounted.

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 系统化联系信息名录；黑色EVA平装；版次截点、排序/索引/页码一致性、纠错重印归属。

rows.label: Professional, technical and scholarly books, in print

title.en-US: Professional, technical and scholarly books, in print
title.zh-CN: 印刷版专业、技术和学术书籍

classification_refs.title: Professional, technical and scholarly books, in print

identity.covered_products: Specialized research, advanced technical and professional-practice titles in the declared complete uncoated-paper EVA-bound paperback construction.
identity.excluded_products: Formal-programme textbooks; public general-reference works; contact directories; children's/general-interest books; periodicals; advertising catalogues; printed music as such; electronic/audio services; every alternative structure or printing/binding route excluded in section 1.
identity.representative_product: One approved edition of a specialist scholarly monograph or professional technical book, complete with its manuscript-required diagrams, formulae and index, in an unlaminated flexible-paper-cover EVA paperback.
identity.production_route: Approved print master → CTP → wet sheetfed text/cover offset and setting → fold/gather → mill/EVA glue/attach cover → trim/inspect → pack and factory-gate dispatch.
identity.market_state: First-quality-released complete printed book at printer gate; net book mass includes retained ink and adhesive, and excludes transport packaging.

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 专业实践/学术专著；EVA平装；经批准的公式/图表/索引/版本完整性，区别正式教材与期刊。

identity.covered_products: Complete child-directed non-textbook fiction/non-fiction, reference, picture and printed drawing/colouring books of the selected uncoated flexible-cover EVA-bound construction.
identity.excluded_products: Formal-study textbooks/workbooks; adult/general-public publications; periodicals; sticker/toy/electronic/sound-module books; blank pads/cards; excluded structures, finishes and printing/binding routes in section 1.
identity.representative_product: One declared children's colouring or picture-book design with uncoated paper pages and flexible uncoated paper cover, conventional wet sheetfed offset and non-reactive EVA milled-spine perfect binding, without detachable/activity inserts.
identity.production_route: File/prepress; process-free CTP; body and cover wet sheetfed offset; absorption/oxidative setting; fold/gather; spine mill; EVA glue and cover attach; trim; first quality release; pack.
identity.market_state: Accepted complete new books at the manufacturing gate; all retained paper, ink, glue and powder belong to net book mass; transport packaging remains separate.

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 非教材儿童纸质绘画/图画书；EVA平装；纸页活动结构、着色介质/图文作用/开合验收，排除玩具和电子。

title.en-US: Adult literary fiction paperbacks: wet sheetfed offset and EVA perfect binding
title.zh-CN: 成人文学小说平装书：湿润单张纸胶印与EVA胶订

identity.covered_products: Complete adult general-interest prose fiction novels made in the specified uncoated-sheet, wet-sheetfed, non-reactive-EVA, flexible-paper-cover construction
identity.excluded_products: Educational/reference/directory/professional/children's titles; periodicals/music/advertising/audio/electronic products; other general-interest book forms; alternative stock, finishing, printing and binding routes listed in section 1
identity.representative_product: One declared adult novel edition, black narrative text, optional CMYK cover, uncoated chemical-pulp paper, milled-spine EVA paperback, complete and accepted at printer gate
identity.production_route: File/prepress; process-free CTP plate imaging; text and cover wet sheetfed offset and absorption/oxidative setting; fold/gather; spine milling; EVA spine/side glue and cover attachment; three-side trim; inspect; pack
identity.market_state: Newly manufactured, first-quality-released complete novel at factory gate; dispatch packaging is accounted separately

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 成人文学小说窄子集；EVA平装；批准叙事版次、黑文/可选CMYK封面、原始批次与返工分开。

title.en-US: Music, printed or in manuscript: dry-toner saddle-stitched scores
title.zh-CN: 印制的或原稿的乐谱：干式碳粉骑马订乐谱册

identity.covered_products: Complete self-covered uncoated paper musical-score booklets with black dry toner and steel saddle staples, accepted for notation reading.
identity.excluded_products: Prose/music-study books without the selected score identity; directories; advertising/catalogues; digital/manuscript/loose/folio products; other substrates, print routes, colours and binding constructions; publishing, retail, licensing, distribution and performance services.
identity.representative_product: One job/design of a monochrome self-covered saddle-stitched paper rehearsal/performance score booklet.
identity.production_route: File checking/imposition → dry electrostatic image transfer → oil-less belt fusing → gather/fold → saddle staple → face trim/inspect → pack.
identity.market_state: Newly first-quality-released complete score at printer gate; packaging excluded from net score mass.

bounded_identity_review.rationale_zh: 完整乐谱；干式碳粉、自封面、骑马钉；熔融/碳粉/臭氧、首次放行Qc与后续损坏分开。

findings.title_zh: 当前方法允许热带芯层，但接受决定仍禁止所有热带层
findings.current_scope: At least one non-tropical non-coniferous outer ply; no tropical outer ply; inner tropical veneers allowed.
findings.decision_scope: At least one non-tropical hardwood outer ply and no tropical plies.
findings.recommendation_zh: 原生通用Volume胶合板流未规定树种，但旧ADR及原接受作者方法均明确排除任何热带层；后续单主人候选审查也明确mapping_accepted=false。建议本轮恢复所有层不得热带的已接受较窄方法范围，保留1m³通用流和现有热量/批群修复，不自动扩大接受。具体EN/ZH候选见31413-conservative-candidate.diff；完整证据见31413-scope-evidence.json。

conclusion_zh: PR30固定头已有1355条已接受映射、0组共享目标。原3组14码已落到14个不同material PCR，11条改指、3条保留；无需再造重复PCR。完成31413范围/持久接受决定一致性修复后方可宣称本次边界审查无阻塞。
review_limits: Read-only pinned Git object review; no canonical/worktree source edits.

Checked accepted mappings, all 14 scope/product identity sections and selected manufacturing/measurement/acceptance distinctions, bilingual identity metadata, durable ADRs, and all material manifest classification declarations; complete method files retained as evidence rather than claiming exhaustive rule review.
Not full scientific review, independent translation approval, external fact verification, runtime projection validation, full repository validation or publication qualification.
